Lin H.: Quick coordination thread: plan to publish the announcement for the new adaptive batching + prefix caching release tomorrow 09:00 PT. We need: final one-line bench stat, changelog link, docs URL, and the precise rollout window + rollback criteria from eng.
Marco G.: Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/501. Highlights: batching.strategy rename (alias kept), performance table, migration steps. QA flagged a minor test flake, aiming to fix today.
Talia R.: Docs ready at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/256. I put a migration checklist and a short sample for SDK/CLI. Will update code sample if param name changes.
Lin H.: Marketing needs a Tweet-sized stat and a 1-sentence blog lede. Keep claims conservative.
Marco G.: Bench headline: "~25% lower token cost; ~40ms p95 improvement on 4k chat baseline." Raw CSV attached to PR.
Talia R.: Webinar slot: 10:30 PT same day, 25m demo + 20m AMA. Events to send reg link.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary starts 2026-04-02T09:00:00-07:00 (5% for 30m -> 25% for 2h -> 100% after 6h). Monitor: https://deploys.redwood.ai/1402
Marco G.: Rollout knobs: feature flag adaptive_batching_v1, auto-rollback if error rate >0.5% or p95 increases >30% for 15m. Start US/EU, APAC ramp next day.
Talia R.: Merged docs once param name confirmed. Docs URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/optimized-batching. Added migration note for batching.strategy alias.
Lin H.: Final checklist: changelog merged, docs live, deploy scheduled, bench blurb approved, webinar page live. Reply with :white_check_mark: when complete.
Marco G.: changelog merged :white_check_mark:
Talia R.: docs live :white_check_mark:
events-team: webinar page published: https://events.redwood.ai/batching-release :white_check_mark:
Lin H.: Thanks team — publishing announcement at 09:00 PT and pushing social at 09:10 PT.
